01 · The list

Every word,
in exam order

TOPIK I is the beginner exam and awards levels 1 and 2 from one paper. The National Institute of Korean Language publishes its beginner vocabulary as one list rather than a list per level; this page holds that list, 1,844 words, which Lock&Learn Korean splits by frequency into the Beginner 1 and Beginner 2 packs. Every entry shows the hangul, its Revised Romanization and an English meaning; the Beginner 1 words, free in the app, also carry a real example sentence with its romanization and translation.

In Lock&Learn Korean this list is the Beginner 1 and Beginner 2 packs: a word waits in hangul with its romanization; one tap reveals the meaning and a real sentence. Beginner 1 is free in the app; Beginner 2 opens with a free preview and another word unlocks daily, or Lock&Learn+ opens every pack at once.

Type to filter by hangul, romanization or meaning. Flashcards hides the meaning until you tap a row; Shuffle deals the list in a new order.

03 · Questions

Asked and
answered

How many words are in the TOPIK I vocabulary list?

1,844. The National Institute of Korean Language grades its learner vocabulary as beginner, intermediate and advanced rather than by TOPIK level. The beginner band, which is the TOPIK I vocabulary, holds about 1,800 words; the intermediate and advanced bands about 2,150 and 2,550.

Is this the official TOPIK TOPIK I word list?

TOPIK itself publishes no vocabulary list. This page follows the National Institute of Korean Language (NIKL) learner vocabulary, the list TOPIK preparation is built on, in the TOPIK I band. The English meanings are Lock&Learn glosses, not an official translation.

How do I study the TOPIK I list on my iPhone Lock Screen?

Install Lock&Learn Korean, then touch and hold your Lock Screen, tap Customize, tap the widget area and choose Lock&Learn Korean. The Beginner 1 and Beginner 2 packs put these words on the widget one at a time: you recall the meaning, one tap reveals it with a real sentence. Beginner 1 is free in the app; Beginner 2 opens with a free preview and another word unlocks daily, or Lock&Learn+ opens every pack at once.

Can I download the TOPIK I vocabulary list as a PDF?

Yes. Use your browser's Print or Save as PDF: the page has a print layout that keeps only the heading and the full table, every word on this list.

Is Lock&Learn Korean free?

Yes. The app is free on iOS: Beginner 1 is free, every other pack opens with a free preview, and another word unlocks daily. Lock&Learn+ is an optional upgrade that opens every pack at once, offered as a yearly plan or a one-time lifetime purchase.
